Changes.note: “Koleksiyona ekle” puts the deck in Koleksiyonum on your Desteler page; it stays there while the deck is public or belongs to a course you are enrolled in, and “Koleksiyondan çıkar” takes it out. The deck itself does not change. “Kendi desteme kopyala” adds the card as it is to one of your own decks; the copy is yours and this deck does not change. A visitor who is not signed in saves nothing.
Data.title: {title}
Deck.aboutPublic: This deck is public: Medaris staff reviewed and published it. Only the deck’s owner changes its cards.
Deck.aboutShared: This deck belongs to a course, köşk or madrasa you are enrolled in; it is not public. Only the deck’s owner changes its cards.
Deck.copyHelp: The card is added to the deck you choose as it is; this deck does not change.
Deck.noOwnDecks: You have no deck of this type. Create one first to copy the card into.
Deck.readerNote: You cannot change this deck’s cards; you can copy a card you like into your own deck.
Public.note: If you study without signing in, your progress is not saved.
